# QnALog 1.6.13

## Highlights

- Recordings now save audio during capture and can recover unfinished recordings after an interruption. On iOS, recording can keep the screen awake and preserve audio when the app moves to the background.
- Note deletion checks protect notes that contain QnALog-generated content. Topic editing supports adding and removing members, handling uncited members, and undoing changes with write confirmation.
- Topic errata can be opened, linked to topic pages, and updated while cleaning content. Topic previews use the target captured when the preview opened.
- Transcription and retry handling now covers blank results, short or anomalous results, empty audio segments, duplicate transcript blocks, and retry cancellation. Pending rows show retry timing, and appending a recording preserves existing audio, people, and speaker properties.

## User impact

The settings schema and API key storage are unchanged. Existing notes are not rewritten during upgrade. Recording recovery data is kept with the plugin's existing recording storage and is used to resume publication after interruption. Topic editing and errata changes apply when users perform those actions.
